ctx.x: But I did quite a bit of recording with him. And I at one time had a marvelous bass player that worked with us by the name of Joe Benjamin, and I liked Joe very much because aside from his playing he was a wonderful person. And Joe also worked with -- opposite us with Sarah Vaughan's group. You know, he played with Sarah for quite a while. But what I want to tell you, for a fleeting moment we all were part of the Gramercy Five. Joe, Benjamin, Charlie Smith, Billy Taylor and myself. We worked for Artie Shaw. That…

Joe McCarthy branded him a communist, and consequently a lot of his bookings were cancelled on account of that. But this Joe McCarthy -- that was a vicious thing because Artie was not a communist, you know. They also had Hazel Scott (Larry), Luther Adler, the harmonica player. Oh, just -- this Joe McCarthy ruined quite a few careers at this -- you know. But I --
Was Artie called before the comm. hear?
